business_summary: Kanaden Corporation operates as an electronics solutions company in Japan and internationally. It provides factory automation systems, including sequencers, inverters, AC servos, robots, and other control and drive systems; wireless sensors, total production control systems, and direct current power supplies; electrical discharge and laser processing machines; power semiconductors and network ICs and memory; connectors and connectors for wired LAN; and wireless modules and solutions. The company provides building facilities equipment, such as hands-free authentication devices, air conditioning management system central controllers, uninterrupted power supplies, elevators, escalators, and led lightings; air conditioner, air-cooling heat pump chiller, refrigeration and cooling system, and open showcase; and net zero energy building Solutions. In addition, it offers video solution systems, security systems, telecommunications equipment, electronic medical care systems, and LED display systems; semiconductors, electronic device, and wireless solution; electric products for rolling stock, substation equipment for receiving electric power, and telecommunication equipment, as well as train vision systems, air conditioning equipment, etc.; and road display panels, LED road lighting fixtures, in-vehicle video recording systems, emergency radio systems, etc., as well as quick charger for electric vehicles. The company was formerly known as Kanagawa Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kanaden Corporation in October 1990. Kanaden Corporation was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
